from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,shutil

 try:

  if any(x in cmd.lower() for x in ['worldedit.exe','war3.exe','exehack.exe']) and not cmd.startswith(('python3 -','bash -')):
   env=(p/'environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0'); prefix=next((x.decode(errors='replace') for x in env if x.startswith(b'WINEPREFIX=')),None)

 except OSError:pass
(out/'processes-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(ps,indent=2))
